# ARQQA Digital

> ARQQA is a full-service digital marketing agency headquartered in Cairo, Egypt, serving brands across the MENA region since 2011. Founded by Wael Saad (former Head of Creative at Yahoo North Africa & Middle East, 2009–2013), ARQQA has evolved from a social media agency into an integrated operational marketing platform. The agency is a certified Google Premier Partner and has generated 20M+ app installs and achieved 61% gross margin efficiency for partners. Primary markets: Egypt, Saudi Arabia (KSA), UAE, and the broader MENA region. Industries served: Fintech, Banking, Real Estate, Aviation, Retail, Telco, Healthcare, E-commerce, Education, and Hospitality.

## Services — Strategy & Consulting

- [Marketing Strategy & Digital Assessment](https://arqqa.net/services/strategy-consulting): Strategic marketing consultation; audit, planning, and roadmap development for brands entering or scaling in MENA markets.
- [Growth Audit](https://arqqa.net/services/strategy-consulting/growth-audit): Diagnostic review of the full funnel to locate where growth is leaking.
- [Go-to-Market Strategy](https://arqqa.net/services/strategy-consulting/go-to-market): Channel mix, audience mapping, KPIs, and launch frameworks tailored to the MENA region.
- [Competitive Analysis](https://arqqa.net/services/strategy-consulting/competitive-analysis): Category and competitor benchmarking to position the brand.
- [Paid Discovery Workshops](https://arqqa.net/services/strategy-consulting/discovery-workshops): Structured working sessions that produce a costed roadmap.

## Services — Performance Marketing

- [Performance Marketing](https://arqqa.net/services/performance-marketing): Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, programmatic buying; campaign management focused on ROAS, CPM, and CPA optimization. Notable result: Nile Air ROAS of 237.

## Services — Social Media Management

- [Social Media Management](https://arqqa.net/services/community-management): Platform strategy, content operations, and day-to-day community management.

- [Social CX Automation](https://arqqa.net/services/community-management/cx-automation): Automated customer-experience flows on social platforms.
- [Social Listening](https://arqqa.net/services/community-management/listening): Monitoring conversation, sentiment, and share of voice.
- [Crisis Handling](https://arqqa.net/services/community-management/crisis): Escalation playbooks and response management.
